name: Tinda Masala
steps: Peel tinda thinly and quarter; remove hard seeds only if mature. Finely chop onion and tomato.
Heat oil and crackle cumin; cook onion 6 minutes until golden. Add ginger and garlic for 1 more minute.
Stir in tomato, turmeric, coriander, chilli and salt; fry 7 minutes until the masala thickens.
Add tinda and water, cover and simmer 15–18 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Uncover to thicken, then stir in garam masala.
tips: Choose small, firm tinda with tender seeds for the best texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
